designBrief: Soft, editorial pastel-pink cafe at Takashimaya, Orchard Road (also has a newer Tanglin outlet). Palette from the business's own real logo (marbled cream/blush) and the real gold storefront signage. Cormorant Garamond for headings, Quicksand for body. Single-page, soft and photography-led, minimal nav. Signature element: a thin 'wander line' dot-path motif with an off-center marker, directly traceable to the brand's own name and 'Eat, Drink & Wander' tagline, used sparingly as a section-heading underline and one full-width divider between hero and About.
